title.en: Volume 3: Annals of Empress Lü Zhi
title.raw: 卷三 高后紀 Volume 3: Annals of Empress Lü Zhi

sentences.zh: 元年春正月，詔曰：「前日孝惠皇帝言欲除三族罪、妖言令，議未決而崩，今除之。」

translations.literal: In the first year, spring, first month, the edict said: 'Previously Emperor Xiaohui spoke of wanting to abolish the three clans punishment and the demonic speech ordinance, but the discussion was not decided when he passed away, now we abolish them.'
translations.idiomatic: In the first year, during the first month of spring, an imperial edict declared: 'Previously, Emperor Xiaohui had expressed a desire to abolish the punishment of the three clans and the ordinance against demonic speech, but the discussion remained unresolved when he passed away. We now abolish them.'

sentences.zh: 二月，賜民爵，戶一級。

translations.literal: Second month, granted the people noble ranks, one level per household.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, noble ranks were granted to the people, one level per household.

sentences.zh: 初置孝弟力田二千石者一人。

translations.literal: First established one person at 2000 shi who is filial, fraternal, and works the fields.
translations.idiomatic: For the first time, one person who exemplifies filial piety, fraternal duty, and dedication to farming was appointed at the rank of 2000 shi.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙申，趙王宮叢臺災。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, bing-shen day: fire struck the Cong Terrace at the Zhao king's palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the bing-shen day of the fifth month in summer, the Cong Terrace in the Zhao king's palace caught fire.

sentences.zh: 立孝惠後宮子強為淮陽王，不疑為恆山王，弘為襄城侯，朝為軹侯，武為壺關侯。

translations.literal: Established Emperor Xiaohui's harem son Qiang as Huaiyang king, Buyi as Hengshan king, Hong as Xiangcheng marquis, Chao as Zhi marquis, Wu as Huguan marquis.
translations.idiomatic: The sons of Emperor Xiaohui's harem were enfeoffed: Qiang as King of Huaiyang, Buyi as King of Hengshan, Hong as Marquis of Xiangcheng, Chao as Marquis of Zhi, and Wu as Marquis of Huguan.

sentences.zh: 秋，桃李華。

translations.literal: Autumn, peach and plum blossomed.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, peach and plum trees came into bloom.

sentences.zh: 二年春，詔曰：「高皇帝匡飭天下，諸有功者皆受分地為列侯，萬民大安，莫不受休德。

translations.literal: Second year spring, edict said: 'Emperor Gao rectified and ordered the realm, all who had merit received divided land as liehou, the myriad people greatly at peace, none did not receive benevolent virtue.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the second year, an imperial edict declared: 'Emperor Gao brought order and discipline to the realm. All who had achieved merit received divided territories as marquises, and the people lived in great peace, all benefiting from his benevolent virtue.

sentences.zh: 朕思念至於久遠 而功名不著，亡以尊大誼，施後世。

translations.literal: I think of this to the distant future but merit and fame are not manifest, there is nothing to honor great righteousness, extend to later generations.
translations.idiomatic: I have reflected on this extending far into the future, yet their merits and achievements remain unrecorded, leaving nothing to honor the great righteousness and pass on to future generations.

sentences.zh: 今欲差次列侯功以定朝位，臧于高廟，世世勿絕，嗣子各襲其功位。

translations.literal: Now wish to differentiate and order the liehou merits to establish court positions, store in the Gao Temple, generation after generation never cease, heir sons each inherit their merit positions.
translations.idiomatic: Now I wish to differentiate and rank the merits of the marquises to establish their positions at court. These rankings shall be preserved in the Gao Temple, maintained generation after generation without interruption, with each heir inheriting his father's meritorious position.

sentences.zh: 其與列侯議定奏之。」

translations.literal: Discuss and decide with the liehou and memorialize it.'
translations.idiomatic: Discuss and determine this with the marquises, then submit a memorial.'

sentences.zh: 丞相臣平言：「謹與絳侯臣勃、曲周 侯臣商、潁陰侯臣嬰、安國侯臣陵等議，列侯幸得賜餐錢奉邑，陛下加惠，以功次定朝位，臣請臧高廟。」

translations.literal: Chancellor Chen Ping said: 'I have respectfully deliberated with Marquis of Jiang Chen Bo, Marquis of Quzhou Chen Shang, Marquis of Yingyin Chen Ying, Marquis of Anguo Chen Ling, and others. The marquises have fortunately received bestowed meal allowances and fief incomes. Your Majesty adds further favor by establishing court positions according to the order of their merits. Your subject requests that they be stored in the Gao Temple.'
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Chen Ping memorialized: 'I have respectfully deliberated with Marquis of Jiang Bo, Marquis of Quzhou Shang, Marquis of Yingyin Ying, Marquis of Anguo Ling, and others. The marquises have fortunately received bestowed meal allowances and fief incomes. Your Majesty adds further favor by establishing court positions according to the order of their merits. I request that these rankings be preserved in the Gao Temple.'

sentences.zh: 奏可。

translations.literal: Memorial approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 春正月乙卯，地震，羌道、武都道山崩。

translations.literal: Spring, first month, yi-mao day: an earthquake; mountains collapsed at Qiangdao and Wudao.
translations.idiomatic: On the yi-mao day of the first month in spring, an earthquake struck, and mountains collapsed at Qiangdao and Wudao.

sentences.zh: 夏六月丙 戌晦，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Summer sixth month bing-xu last day, the sun was eclipsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day of the sixth month in summer, a bing-xu day, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，恆山王不疑薨。

translations.literal: Autumn seventh month, Hengshan king Buyi passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, King Buyi of Hengshan passed away.

sentences.zh: 行八銖錢。

translations.literal: Circulated eight zhu coins.
translations.idiomatic: Eight-zhu coins were put into circulation.

sentences.zh: 三年夏，江水、溢，流民四千餘家。

translations.literal: Third year summer, Yangtze River overflowed, flooded people four thousand plus households.
translations.idiomatic: In summer of the third year, the Yangtze River overflowed its banks, displacing more than four thousand households.

sentences.zh: 秋，星晝見。

translations.literal: Autumn, stars seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, stars were visible during the daytime.

sentences.zh: 四年夏，少帝自知非皇后子，出怨言，皇太后幽之永巷。

translations.literal: Fourth year, summer: the young emperor knew himself not the empress's son and uttered resentful words; the empress dowager confined him in the Everlasting Lane.
translations.idiomatic: In summer of the fourth year, the young emperor realized he was not the empress's son and spoke words of resentment. The Empress Dowager confined him in the Everlasting Lane.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「凡有天下治萬民者，蓋之如天，容之如 地；

translations.literal: Edict said: 'All who govern the realm and rule the myriad people, cover them like heaven, contain them like earth;
translations.idiomatic: An imperial edict declared: 'All who govern the realm and rule the myriad people should cover them like heaven and contain them like earth;

sentences.zh: 上有驩心以使百姓，百姓欣然以事其上，驩欣交通而天下治。

translations.literal: Above has happy heart to employ the hundred clans, the hundred clans joyfully serve their superiors, happy and joyful communicate and the realm is governed.
translations.idiomatic: Above, there should be a joyful heart to employ the people, and the people should joyfully serve their superiors. When joy flows between ruler and subjects, the realm is well governed.

sentences.zh: 今皇帝疾久不已，乃失惑昏亂，不能繼嗣奉宗廟，守祭祀，不可屬天下。

translations.literal: Now the emperor's illness long not cured, moreover confused and disordered, cannot continue and serve the ancestral temple, guard the sacrifices, cannot be entrusted with the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Now the emperor's illness has persisted without cure, and moreover he has become confused and disordered. He cannot continue the line and serve the ancestral temple, nor guard the sacrifices. He cannot be entrusted with governing the realm.

sentences.zh: 其議代之。」

translations.literal: Discuss replacing him.'
translations.idiomatic: Discuss who should replace him.'

sentences.zh: 群臣皆曰： 「皇太后為天下計，所以安宗廟社稷甚深。

translations.literal: All the ministers said: 'The Empress Dowager has acted for the welfare of the realm, thereby securing the ancestral temple and altars of soil and grain in the profoundest way.
translations.idiomatic: All the ministers declared: 'The Empress Dowager has acted for the welfare of the realm, thereby securing the ancestral temple and altars of soil and grain in the profoundest way.

sentences.zh: 頓首奉詔。」

translations.literal: Bow heads and receive the edict.'
translations.idiomatic: We bow our heads and receive the edict.'

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，立恆山王弘為皇帝。

translations.literal: Fifth month bing-chen day, established Hengshan king Hong as emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On the bing-chen day of the fifth month, King Hong of Hengshan was established as emperor.

sentences.zh: 五年春，南粵王尉佗自稱南武帝。

translations.literal: Fifth year spring, Nanyue king Zhao Tuo self-called Southern Martial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fifth year, Zhao Tuo, king of Nanyue, proclaimed himself the Southern Martial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，淮陽王彊薨。

translations.literal: Autumn eighth month, Huaiyang king Qiang passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, King Qiang of Huaiyang passed away.

sentences.zh: 九月，發河東、上黨騎屯北地。

translations.literal: Ninth month, dispatched Hedong, Shangdang cavalry to garrison Beidi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, cavalry from Hedong and Shangdang were dispatched to garrison Beidi.

sentences.zh: 六年春，星晝見。

translations.literal: Sixth year spring, stars seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the sixth year, stars were visible during the daytime.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，赦天下。

translations.literal: Summer fourth month, amnesty the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, a general amnesty was granted throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 秩長陵令二千石。

translations.literal: The rank of the magistrate of Changling was set at two thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: The rank of the magistrate of Changling was set at two thousand shi.

sentences.zh: 六月，城長陵。

translations.literal: Sixth month, walled Changling.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, walls were built around Changling.

sentences.zh: 匈奴寇狄道，攻阿陽。

translations.literal: Xiongnu raided Di Dao, attacked A Yang.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiongnu raided Di Dao and attacked A Yang.

sentences.zh: 行五分錢。

translations.literal: Circulated five parts coin.
translations.idiomatic: Five-parts coins were put into circulation.

sentences.zh: 八年春，封中謁者張釋卿為列侯。

translations.literal: Eighth year, spring: enfeoffed the palace attendant Zhang Shiqing as a marquis.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the eighth year, the palace attendant Zhang Shiqing was enfeoffed as a marquis.

sentences.zh: 諸中官、宦者令丞皆賜爵關內侯，食邑。

translations.literal: All palace officials and eunuch officials and their assistants were all granted the rank of marquis within the passes, with food fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: All palace officials and eunuch officials and their assistants were granted the rank of marquis within the passes, with food fiefs.

sentences.zh: 夏，江水、漢水溢，流萬餘家。

translations.literal: Summer, Yangtze River, Han River overflowed, flooded ten thousand plus households.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the Yangtze and Han rivers overflowed their banks, displacing more than ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳，皇太后崩于未央宮。

translations.literal: Autumn seventh month xin-si day, Empress Dowager passed away in Weiyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the xin-si day of the seventh month in autumn, the Empress Dowager passed away in Weiyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 遺詔賜諸侯王各千金，將相列侯下至郎吏各有差。

translations.literal: Bequeathed edict granted the various regional kings each one thousand gold, generals and chancellors liehou down to the lang officials each according to difference.
translations.idiomatic: By bequeathed edict, the various regional kings were each granted one thousand pieces of gold, while generals, chancellors, marquises, and officials down to the lang rank each received amounts according to their position.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: Great amnesty the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A great amnesty was granted throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 上將軍祿、相國產顓兵秉政，自知背高皇帝約，恐為大臣諸侯王所誅，因謀作亂。

translations.literal: Senior General Lü Lu and Chancellor of State Lü Chan monopolized the army and held power. Knowing they had violated Emperor Gaozu's covenant, they feared execution by the ministers and regional kings, and therefore plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Senior General Lü Lu and Chancellor of State Lü Chan monopolized the army and held power. Knowing they had violated Emperor Gaozu's covenant, they feared execution by the ministers and regional kings, and therefore plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 時齊悼惠王子朱虛侯章 在京師，以祿女為婦，知其謀，乃使人告兄齊王，令發兵西。

translations.literal: At the time, Zhu Xu Marquis Zhang, son of King Daohui of Qi, was in the capital. He had taken Lü Lu's daughter as his wife, knew of their plot, and sent men to inform his elder brother the King of Qi, ordering him to dispatch troops west.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, Zhu Xu Marquis Zhang, son of King Daohui of Qi, was in the capital. Married to Lü Lu's daughter, he knew of their plot and sent messengers to inform his elder brother, the King of Qi, ordering him to dispatch troops westward.

sentences.zh: 章欲與太尉勃、丞相平為內應，以誅諸呂。

translations.literal: Zhang wished to act as an inside responder with Grand Commandant Zhou Bo and Chancellor Chen Ping to execute the various Lü.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang wished to coordinate internally with Grand Commandant Zhou Bo and Chancellor Chen Ping to execute the various members of the Lü clan.

sentences.zh: 齊王遂發兵，又詐琅邪王澤發其國兵，并將而西。

translations.literal: Qi king then dispatched troops, moreover deceived Langye king Ze to dispatch his country's troops, combined led and went west.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Qi then dispatched troops, and moreover deceived King Ze of Langye into dispatching his country's forces. They combined their armies and marched westward.

sentences.zh: 產、祿等 遣大將軍灌嬰將兵擊之。

translations.literal: Lü Chan, Lü Lu, and the others dispatched Grand General Guan Ying to lead troops against them.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Chan and Lü Lu dispatched Grand General Guan Ying to lead troops against them.

sentences.zh: 嬰至滎陽，使人諭齊王與連和，待呂氏變而共誅之。

translations.literal: Ying reached Xingyang and sent men to persuade the King of Qi to ally with him, waiting for a change among the Lü before jointly executing them.
translations.idiomatic: When Ying reached Xingyang, he sent messengers to persuade the King of Qi to form an alliance, waiting for a turn among the Lü before jointly executing them.

sentences.zh: 太尉勃與丞相平謀，以曲周侯酈商子寄與祿善，使人劫商令寄紿說祿曰：「高帝與呂后共定天下，劉氏所 立九王，呂氏所立三王，皆大臣之議。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant Zhou Bo and Chancellor Chen Ping plotted. Since Marquis of Quzhou Li Shang's son Ji was on good terms with Lü Lu, they sent men to seize Shang and have Ji deceive and persuade Lü Lu, saying: 'Emperor Gaozu and Empress Lü together settled the realm. The Liu clan established nine kings and the Lü clan established three kings—all were matters deliberated by the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Zhou Bo and Chancellor Chen Ping plotted together. Since Marquis of Quzhou Li Shang's son Ji was on good terms with Lü Lu, they sent men to seize Shang and have Ji deceive and persuade Lü Lu, saying: 'Emperor Gaozu and Empress Lü together settled the realm. The Liu clan established nine kings and the Lü clan established three kings—all were matters deliberated by the ministers.

sentences.zh: 事以布告諸侯王，諸侯王以為宜。

translations.literal: Matters with announcements proclaim to the various regional kings, the various regional kings considered it appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: These matters were proclaimed by announcement to the various regional kings, who all considered them appropriate.

sentences.zh: 今太后崩，帝少，足下不急之國守藩，乃為上將將兵留此，為大臣諸侯所疑。

translations.literal: Now the Empress Dowager has passed away and the emperor is young. You do not urgently return to your state to guard your border, but instead as senior general lead troops and remain here, causing ministers and regional kings to suspect you.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Empress Dowager has passed away and the emperor is young. You do not urgently return to your state to guard your border, but instead as senior general you lead troops and remain here, causing ministers and regional kings to suspect you.

sentences.zh: 何不速歸將軍 印，以兵屬太尉，請梁王亦歸相國印，與大臣盟而之國？

translations.literal: Why not quickly return the general's seal and entrust the troops to the Grand Commandant? Request that the King of Liang also return the chancellor's seal, ally with the ministers, and return to your state?
translations.idiomatic: Why not quickly return the general's seal and entrust the troops to the Grand Commandant? Request that the King of Liang also return the chancellor's seal, ally with the ministers, and return to your state?

sentences.zh: 齊兵必罷，大臣得安，足下高枕而王千里，此萬世之利也。」

translations.literal: Qi troops certainly will stop, ministers can be at peace, you can recline pillow and be king of a thousand li, this is ten thousand generations' benefit.'
translations.idiomatic: The Qi troops will certainly withdraw, allowing the ministers to rest easy. You can recline on your pillow and rule as king of a thousand li territory - this is a benefit for ten thousand generations.'

sentences.zh: 祿然其計，使人報產及諸呂老人。

translations.literal: Lü Lu approved the plan and sent men to report to Lü Chan and the elders of the Lü clan.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Lu approved the plan and sent messengers to inform Lü Chan and the elders of the Lü clan.

sentences.zh: 或以為不 便，計猶豫未有所決。

translations.literal: Some considered it inappropriate, the plan hesitated not yet decided.
translations.idiomatic: Some considered it inappropriate, and the plan remained undecided amid hesitation.

sentences.zh: 祿信寄，與俱出遊，過其姑呂嬃。

translations.literal: Lü Lu trusted Ji, went out touring with him, and passed his aunt Lü Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Lu trusted Ji and went out touring with him, passing by his aunt Lü Xu.

sentences.zh: 嬃怒曰：「奴為將而棄軍，呂氏今無處矣！」

translations.literal: Xu said angrily: 'You slave—as a general you abandon the army; the Lü clan now has nowhere to turn!'
translations.idiomatic: Lü Xu said angrily: 'You slave—as a general you abandon the army; the Lü clan now has nowhere to turn!'

sentences.zh: 乃悉出珠玉寶器散堂下，曰：「無為它人守也！」

translations.literal: Then completely took out pearls jade precious vessels scattered below the hall, said: 'Do not guard for other people!'
translations.idiomatic: She then took out all the pearls, jade, and precious vessels, scattering them below the hall, saying: 'Don't guard these for other people!'

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，平陽侯窋行御史大夫事，見相國產計事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, geng-shen day: Pingyang Marquis Kui, acting as Imperial Censor-in-Chief, went to see Chancellor of State Lü Chan to discuss affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the geng-shen day of the eighth month, Pingyang Marquis Kui, acting as Imperial Censor-in-Chief, went to see Chancellor of State Lü Chan to discuss affairs.

sentences.zh: 郎中令賈壽使從齊來，因數產曰：「王不早之國，今 雖欲行，尚可得邪？」

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Commander Jia Shou had a messenger come from Qi who, on this occasion, rebuked Chan, saying: 'The king did not return to his state early; now even if he wishes to go, can he still do so?'
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Commander Jia Shou had a messenger come from Qi who, on this occasion, rebuked Chan, saying: 'The king did not return to his state early; now even if he wishes to go, can he still do so?'

sentences.zh: 具以灌嬰與齊楚合從狀告產。

translations.literal: He fully reported to Chan the situation of Guan Ying's alliance with Qi and Chu.
translations.idiomatic: He fully reported to Chan the situation of Guan Ying's alliance with Qi and Chu.

sentences.zh: 平陽侯窋聞其語，馳告丞相平、太尉勃。

translations.literal: Pingyang Marquis Kui heard their words and galloped to inform Chancellor Chen Ping and Grand Commandant Zhou Bo.
translations.idiomatic: Pingyang Marquis Kui heard their conversation and galloped to inform Chancellor Chen Ping and Grand Commandant Zhou Bo.

sentences.zh: 勃欲入北軍，不得入。

translations.literal: Zhou Bo wished to enter the Northern Army but could not.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Bo wished to enter the Northern Army but was unable to do so.

sentences.zh: 襄平侯紀通尚符節，乃令持節矯內勃北軍。

translations.literal: Xiangping Marquis Ji Tong still held the tally and credentials; they then ordered him to use the credentials to forge a command admitting Zhou Bo into the Northern Army.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangping Marquis Ji Tong still held the tally and credentials. They then ordered him to use the credentials to forge a command admitting Zhou Bo into the Northern Army.

sentences.zh: 勃復 令酈寄、典客劉揭說祿，曰：「帝使太尉守北軍，欲令足下之國，急歸將軍印辭去。

translations.literal: Zhou Bo again ordered Li Ji and Protocol Director Liu Jie to persuade Lü Lu, saying: 'The emperor has made the Grand Commandant guard the Northern Army and wishes you to return to your state. Urgently return the general's seal and depart.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Bo then ordered Li Ji and Protocol Director Liu Jie to persuade Lü Lu, saying: 'The emperor has made the Grand Commandant guard the Northern Army and wishes you to return to your state. Urgently return the general's seal and depart.

sentences.zh: 不然，禍且起。」

translations.literal: If not, calamity will arise.'
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, calamity will ensue.'

sentences.zh: 祿遂解印屬典客，而以兵授太尉勃。

translations.literal: Lü Lu then removed his seal and entrusted it to the Protocol Director, and handed the troops over to Grand Commandant Zhou Bo.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Lu then removed his seal and entrusted it to the Protocol Director, handing command of the troops over to Grand Commandant Zhou Bo.

sentences.zh: 勃入軍門，行令軍中曰： 「為呂氏右袒，為劉氏左袒。」

translations.literal: Zhou Bo entered the army gate and issued a command in the army, saying: 'Those for the Lü clan, bare the right shoulder; those for the Liu clan, bare the left shoulder.'
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Bo entered the army gate and issued a command throughout the army: 'Those for the Lü clan, bare the right shoulder; those for the Liu clan, bare the left shoulder.'

sentences.zh: 軍皆左袒。

translations.literal: The army all bared left arms.
translations.idiomatic: The entire army bared their left arms.

sentences.zh: 勃遂將北軍。

translations.literal: Zhou Bo then took command of the Northern Army.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Bo then took command of the Northern Army.

sentences.zh: 然尚有南軍，丞相平召朱虛侯章佐勃。

translations.literal: However, the Southern Army still remained; Chancellor Chen Ping summoned Zhu Xu Marquis Zhang to assist Zhou Bo.
translations.idiomatic: However, the Southern Army still remained. Chancellor Chen Ping summoned Zhu Xu Marquis Zhang to assist Zhou Bo.

sentences.zh: 勃令章監軍門，令平陽侯告衛尉，毋內相國產殿門。

translations.literal: Zhou Bo ordered Zhang to oversee the army gate and commanded Pingyang Marquis to inform the Guard Commander not to admit Chancellor of State Lü Chan through the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Bo ordered Zhang to oversee the army gate and commanded Pingyang Marquis to inform the Guard Commander not to admit Chancellor of State Lü Chan through the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 產不知祿已去北 軍，入未央宮欲為亂。

translations.literal: Lü Chan, not knowing that Lü Lu had already left the Northern Army, entered Weiyang Palace intending to make rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Unaware that Lü Lu had already left the Northern Army, Lü Chan entered Weiyang Palace intending to start a rebellion.

sentences.zh: 殿門弗內，徘徊往來。

translations.literal: Palace gate not admitted, paced back and forth.
translations.idiomatic: The palace gate would not admit him, so he paced back and forth outside.

sentences.zh: 平陽侯馳語太尉勃，勃尚恐不勝，未敢誦言誅之，乃謂朱虛侯章曰：「急入宮衛帝。」

translations.literal: Pingyang Marquis galloped to inform Grand Commandant Zhou Bo. Zhou Bo still feared they might not prevail and dared not openly proclaim the order to execute him. He then said to Zhu Xu Marquis Zhang: 'Enter the palace at once to guard the emperor.'
translations.idiomatic: Pingyang Marquis galloped to inform Grand Commandant Zhou Bo. Zhou Bo still feared they might not prevail and dared not openly proclaim the order to execute him. He then said to Zhu Xu Marquis Zhang: 'Enter the palace at once to guard the emperor.'

sentences.zh: 章從勃請卒千人，入未央宮掖 門，見產廷中。

translations.literal: Zhang requested one thousand troops from Zhou Bo, entered Weiyang Palace through the side gate, and saw Lü Chan in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang requested one thousand troops from Zhou Bo and entered Weiyang Palace through the side gate, where he saw Lü Chan in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 日餔時，遂擊產。

translations.literal: At the hour of the afternoon meal, they attacked Lü Chan.
translations.idiomatic: At the hour of the afternoon meal, they attacked Lü Chan.

sentences.zh: 產走。

translations.literal: Lü Chan fled.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Chan fled.

sentences.zh: 天大風，從官亂，莫敢鬥者。

translations.literal: A fierce wind arose; the attendant officials were thrown into chaos, and none dared fight.
translations.idiomatic: A fierce wind arose; the attendant officials were thrown into chaos, and none dared to fight.

sentences.zh: 逐產，殺之郎中府吏舍廁中。

translations.literal: They pursued Lü Chan and killed him in the privy of the clerk's quarters in the Langzhong office.
translations.idiomatic: They pursued Lü Chan and killed him in the privy of the clerk's quarters in the Langzhong office.

sentences.zh: 章已殺產，帝令謁者持節勞章。

translations.literal: After Zhang had killed Lü Chan, the emperor ordered a courtier to hold the credentials and console Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhang had killed Lü Chan, the emperor ordered a courtier to hold the credentials and console Zhang.

sentences.zh: 章欲奪節，謁者不肯，章乃從與載，因節信馳斬長樂衛尉呂更始。

translations.literal: Zhang wished to seize the credentials, but the courtier refused. Zhang then rode along with him and, by the authority of the credentials, galloped to behead Changle Guard Commander Lü Gengshi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang wished to seize the credentials, but the courtier refused. Zhang then rode along with him and, by the authority of the credentials, galloped to behead Changle Guard Commander Lü Gengshi.

sentences.zh: 還入北軍，復報太尉勃。

translations.literal: He returned and entered the Northern Army, then reported again to Grand Commandant Zhou Bo.
translations.idiomatic: He returned and entered the Northern Army, then reported again to Grand Commandant Zhou Bo.

sentences.zh: 勃起拜賀章，曰：「所患獨產，今已誅，天下定矣。」

translations.literal: Zhou Bo rose, bowed, and congratulated Zhang, saying: 'The one we feared was only Lü Chan; now that he has been executed, the realm is settled.'
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Bo rose, bowed, and congratulated Zhang, saying: 'The one we feared was only Lü Chan; now that he has been executed, the realm is settled.'

sentences.zh: 辛酉，

translations.literal: Xin-you,
translations.idiomatic: On xin-you day,

sentences.zh: 殺呂祿，笞殺呂嬃。

translations.literal: They killed Lü Lu and flogged Lü Xu to death.
translations.idiomatic: They killed Lü Lu and flogged Lü Xu to death.

sentences.zh: 分部悉捕諸呂男女，無少長皆斬之。

translations.literal: Divided commands completely captured the various Lü males and females, regardless of young or old all beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: They divided into commands and completely captured all males and females of the Lü clan, beheading them regardless of age.

sentences.zh: 大臣相與陰謀，以為少帝及三弟為王者皆非孝惠子，復共誅之，尊立文帝。

translations.literal: Ministers mutually secretly plotted, considered the young emperor and three younger brothers who were kings all not Xiaohui's sons, again together executed them, honored and established Wen emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers secretly plotted together, determining that the young emperor and his three younger brothers who were kings were all not sons of Emperor Xiaohui. They executed them as well and honored Emperor Wen by establishing him on the throne.

sentences.zh: 語在周勃、高五王傳。

translations.literal: The account is given in the biographies of Zhou Bo and the Five Sons of Emperor Gao.
translations.idiomatic: The account is given in the biographies of Zhou Bo and the Five Sons of Emperor Gao.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：孝惠、高后之時，海內得離戰國之苦，君臣俱欲無為，故惠帝拱己，高后女主制政，不出房闥，而天下晏然，刑罰罕用，民務稼穡，衣食滋殖。

translations.literal: The commentator says: In the time of Emperor Xiaohui and Empress Lü, the realm within the seas obtained release from the sufferings of the Warring States. Ruler and ministers alike wished for non-action; therefore Emperor Hui held to a hands-off posture, while Empress Lü, as female ruler, held power without leaving her chambers—yet the realm was tranquil, punishments were rarely used, the people devoted themselves to farming, and clothing and food grew ever more abundant.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: During the reigns of Emperor Xiaohui and Empress Lü, the realm obtained release from the sufferings of the Warring States period. Ruler and ministers alike wished for non-action; therefore Emperor Hui held to a hands-off posture, while Empress Lü, as female ruler, held power without leaving her chambers—yet the realm remained peaceful, punishments were rarely used, the people devoted themselves to farming, and clothing and food grew ever more abundant.
